component.name: LAN-Drop
component.summary: Fast, secure, cross-platform local and global P2P file transfer

description.p: LAN-Drop is an ultra-fast, privacy-first peer-to-peer file transfer engine designed for cross-platform desktop, mobile, and web environments. It features automated local network discovery via UDP multicast/mDNS and seamless global transfers across disparate NATs using WebRTC DataChannels and hardened Coturn relays.

ul.li: Local zero-configuration device discovery with radar visualization.
Global P2P transfers using 8-character Crockford Base32 room codes.
Zero cloud storage: all data is streamed directly between peers using DTLS 1.3 encryption.
Resilient multi-gigabyte streaming with Wire Protocol v2 chunking and crash recovery.
Zero telemetry, zero analytics, and zero tracking.

screenshot.caption: Radar discovery view showing nearby peers
High-throughput P2P transfer progress and SHA-256 validation

ul.li: Integrated multi-stage containerized signaling and TURN deployment.
Full Debian (.deb) and AppImage packaging support.
Integrated lan_drop doctor diagnostic command for network health audits.
Resilient byte-offset resumption for interrupted transfers.

description.p: Initial stable release with Qt 6 desktop radar and local TLS transfer engine.
